title: skill-evals: a --triggers-only flag, so a skill-description change can be measured on its trigger cases alone
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1ZJL93Kin2UHFXbFv

Filing gate ②: an instrument gap met while pre-claiming #34769 (a4-A), on the seat's routing (seat 4, 2026-11-20 00:54Z: option B). Dedupe: `skill-evals trigger only flag` — no open card; #34768 (runner) and #34789 (trigger cases) are closed.

Suggested-grade: p2 · blocks the Done-when measurement of #34769 (p2), which is about trigger behaviour only.

## What

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals` has no way to run only the trigger cases (`should_trigger`) of the selected bundles. `--skills` takes whole bundles, so a round on the six metadata bundles of #34769 (`objectstack-{data,ui,automation,formula,i18n,query}`) plans 156 behaviour cases × 2 arms + 42 trigger cases ≈ 354 turns, while the measurement #34769 owes needs only the 42 trigger turns. Before and after, that is ~700 subscription turns against ~84.

## Ask

Add `--triggers-only` to `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cli.ts`: select only `should_trigger` cases (with-skill arm), recorded and summarised as today's trigger table; refused beside nothing it cannot honour; `--dry-run` shows the reduced plan; self-test fixture both directions. Works with `--skills-from <version>` so the "before" leg can run on the published bundles after the description change has merged.

## Done when

`skill-evals --skills objectstack-data,objectstack-ui,objectstack-automation,objectstack-formula,objectstack-i18n,objectstack-query --triggers-only --dry-run` plans 42 turns; the runner self-test passes.

Relations: unblocks the measurement half of #34769. Lane: eval tooling (`packages/qa/scenarios`), not a4-A's paths.
